core_rule: Universal Sequence is the execution grammar. Human, AI, Wisdom and ASI are registries that provide state, capability, principle and governance inputs through ASI Nodes. None of the rubrics replaces the Sequence graph.

HUMAN.role: Represent Human state, capability, experience, motivation, learning and write-back.

AI.role: Provide native artificial-cognition mechanisms for representation, reasoning, planning, execution, verification and adaptation.

WISDOM.role: Provide source-linked contextual principles, narrative patterns, long-horizon consequences, counter-cases and applicability conditions.
cannot_do: Become law without a formation Sequence

ASI.role: Provide meta-governance across domains, Sequences, memories, priorities, rules, contradictions, resources and closure scopes.

node_connections.when: reverse mining requires narrative, scripture, commentary, law or source-derived prior events
driver/rule/priority conflict requires contextual principle or civilizational pattern
priority, rule, promise, permission or goal conflict crosses domains
source-linked guidance, precedent, narrative pattern or value context is relevant
cross-domain governance, global policy, closure scope or meta-control is implicated

node_connections.return: qualified source claim or unresolved source gap

node_connections.when: candidate paths conflict on priority, authority, wisdom, safety or long-horizon consequence
verification has cross-domain truth, authority or closure implications
a repeated pattern may become a wisdom/principle candidate
node_connections.return: context-bounded wisdom object or rejected generalization

node_connections.when: cross-sequence coordination requires global policy or goal arbitration
any native AI mechanism must be selected
approved meta-governance must be enforced across active Sequences

conflict_convergence.output: legal path, blocked path, unresolved contradiction, new investigation Sequence, or explicit no-action

hard_guards: No domain may silently write into another domain's native registry.
Every cross-domain value carries owner/source metadata.
Wisdom is advisory/contextual until the active Sequence and ASI governance accept its applicability.
AI mechanisms generate/transform candidates but cannot bypass evidence, threshold, barrier or closure law.
ASI meta-governance can block or route but cannot invent missing source truth.
